Settling is set by the decay envelope 4/2.22=1.80 s, matching measured 1.81 s and failing the 1.35 s spec, while fast poles at -150, -2000, -2663 decay quickly and do not dominate. Actuator hits 10 V only 1.7% of time so saturation is not causing the oscillation, it is just P too high relative to D with kd only 0.1.
